author: Aaronjacobs000
summary: These parsers read Huawei USG and HiSecEngine firewall info-center logs and syslog session logs, sent over syslog to the data collector. Session and policy logs go to Netflow, IPS and WAF logs to NIDS, AV logs to Antivirus, URL filtering to HTTP, SSL VPN and web UI sign-ins to Auth, and security policy rule changes to ManagementEvent.
notes:
Setup:
- Send the info-center logs and the syslog session logs (default format, not MTN, NetFlow or a custom template) to the data collector. The README has the commands.

Field mapping:
- Policy permit and deny logs, SECLOG session builds, teardowns and drop records go to Netflow (deny, drop and policy-deny closes as blocked); IPS detect, botnet, trojan, worm and domain logs and WAF logs to NIDS; AV virus and file reputation logs to Antivirus; URL filtering to HTTP; SSL VPN and web UI sign-ins, failures and sign-outs to Auth; security policy rule changes to ManagementEvent.
- Other messages of the POLICY, SECLOG, IPS, AV, URL, WAF, SSLVPN and WEBM modules stay generic.
- A protocol is read as a number or a name.
- In Sophos NG-SIEM, SPLIT_NAME_VALUES splits a quoted value at a comma and adds an item that has no key to the value before it, so the parent makes each Key=Value item its own first, matching a quoted value whole, and reads the drop record's destination zone from the text.

Time:
- The time is read with its zone (date, format-date, rfc-3339 and short-date); without-timezone times are read as UTC.
- Huawei doesn't document the format of BeginTime, EndTime or the policy log's time, so they are kept as sent (session times in event_metadata).

Sources and licenses:
- How sure this is: the message templates and parameter values come from Huawei's HiSecEngine USG6000F V600R025C10 Log Reference, whose pages open only in a browser.
- Huawei shows no syslog session log line with its header, so the parser expects the info-center header its Log Reference describes; that part is inferred.

Made up in the samples:
- Samples are made up from the templates.

Testing:
- The parsers passed Run Test in a lab tenant on 2026-10-16: each child combined with the parent into one parser (294 of 294 fields matched the emulator in each of 3 runs), and each child as a separate parser under its parent (290 of 290 fields, each line taken in 5 of 5 runs, and the parent-only line matched).
- No built-in parser claimed these lines in 3 runs.
- In Run Test on 2026-10-16 a URL page that holds a comma came out whole and all 310 fields matched.

Known gaps:
- CLI and SSH sign-ins and command records are the same VRP messages on every Huawei device, so the Huawei VRP switches and routers entry reads them; add both for full coverage.
